records.name: eWorkConnection
records.tagline: Job search, organized: resumes, matches, mock interviews
records.description: eWorkConnection is a career workspace that turns a resume or target role into a focused search: matched jobs, ATS-ready resume drafts, AI mock interviews, prep podcasts, and a follow-up tracker — all in one place instead of five tabs and a spreadsheet.

records.name: Easibill
records.tagline: Modern billing & customer retention for growing pharmacy.
records.description: EasiBill is an all-in-one business operating platform built for pharmacies, clinics, retailers, and growing MSMEs. Unlike traditional billing software that only generates invoices, EasiBill helps businesses manage inventory, customer relationships, automated follow-ups, and repeat sales from a single dashboard.

records.name: AI-Native Contract Intelligence
records.tagline: Agents execute + humans govern.
records.description: Discover AI-native contract intelligence that powers autonomous contracting - Engage, Operate, Analyze with Vera AI.

records.name: BounceProtect
records.tagline: Smarter Email Validation for Better Deliverability
records.description: Bounce Protect is an advanced email validation and deliverability platform that helps businesses reduce bounce rates, protect sender reputation, and improve email marketing performance. Verify single emails or bulk email lists with powerful email verification tools, real-time API integration, domain analysis, and deliverability insights. Designed for marketers, agencies, SaaS companies, and sales teams seeking accurate, fast, and reliable email validation.

records.name: 8-0 world cup
records.tagline: A 8-0 2026 world cup simulator
records.description: Play the best 8-0 world cup simulator. Build your squad, dominate the bracket, and win the 8-0 world cup. Are you ready for the ultimate 8-0 game?

records.name: Online Image Resizer
records.tagline: Online Image Resizer without Losing Quality
records.description: Free online Image Resizer tool. Supports resizing and converting to JPG, PNG, WebP while maintaining high quality. 100% browser-based security.

records.name: Knowledge Builder for Freshdesk
records.tagline: From every ticket, a smarter knowledge base
records.description: Knowledge Builder automatically turns resolved Freshdesk tickets into high-quality knowledge base articles using AI. Stop KB rot. Ship a living knowledge base.

records.name: Ai voice widget
records.tagline: Ai voice widget for FAQ and Qurries
records.description: Ai voice widget for website for FAQ ans Qurries Easy Train your website in minuets and run

records.name: Field force automation Software
records.tagline: Smarter Field Execution. Better Business Results.
records.description: Appilary Technologies develops AI-driven field force automation and retail execution software that enables real-time reporting, GPS tracking, task management, route scheduling, and analytics for sales and marketing teams.

records.name: Senthor
records.tagline: Get paid every time AI crawls your content
records.description: AI crawlers scrape millions of publisher pages daily. robots.txt is ignored. Paywalls are bypassed. Publishers earn nothing. Senthor sits at the server level, fingerprints AI bots in real time, and triggers a machine-to-machine micropayment before content is delivered. No code change needed. Publishers plug in, set a price per crawl, and start earning. AI companies get clean licensed access. Publishers get a new revenue stream. The open web gets a sustainable model.

records.name: Get lost love back permanently
records.tagline: Lost your true love? Get them back permanently!
records.description: Get your lost love back permanently with the expert guidance of Astro Abhinav Sharma. His astrological solutions offer a lasting way to reunite with your partner and rebuild your relationship.

records.name: PortKill9
records.tagline: Kill ports instantly on macOS. No terminal, no lsof,
records.description: PortKill9 is a native macOS app that kills any process occupying a port — one click, one second, done. No more typing `lsof -i :3000`, finding PID, running `kill -9`. Just enter your port number and hit Kill. Built for developers who restart local servers daily and constantly fight "port already in use" errors. Especially handy for vibe coding workflows where you're spinning up and tearing down dev environments all day long. Native macOS experience. Zero dependencies. Just works.

records.name: RUCKUS2 TKP
records.tagline: The ultimate street-surfing machine, pre-dialed to carve.
records.description: Step straight into deep street surfing with Ruckus2 TKP. Featuring a dual Traditional Kingpin geometry pre-dialed for pure carving right out of the box, next-gen PROFOC ESC power delivery, and tool-less Bravura quick-release hubs.

records.name: Paytev.com
records.tagline: Making Wealth Creation Accessible to Everyone
records.description: A modern investment platform built to make wealth creation accessible, simple and transparent. Invest smarter, grow consistently, and take control of your financial future- all from one secure platform

records.name: Loftlyy
records.tagline: A constantly growing database of brand identity.
records.description: Discover and explore brand identities, logos, colors, and design systems. Brand identity of brands for inspiration.

records.name: Pulse.core
records.tagline: Your daily health score — sleep, heart rate, HRV and more.
records.description: Pulse gives you a daily score from 0 to 100 based on your real health data — sleep, resting heart rate, HRV, steps and more. Every morning, Pulse analyzes what happened while you slept and surfaces what matters: anomalies detected, recovery status, and personalized insights from Lumo, your AI health assistant.

records.name: AutoScroll
records.tagline: Autoscroll your browser at the perfect reading speed
records.description: AutoScroll lets you set a steady scroll speed so you can read without touching your mouse. Toggle with a keyboard shortcut, adjust speed on the fly, and save your favorite presets. Free up to 1.5×. Pro goes to 5× with saved presets. Built for people who read a lot — long articles, docs, research papers, newsletters.

records.name: JustAsk
records.tagline: Kill the messy 'quick question' email for good
records.description: AI-powered form builder. Describe your form in plain English, it builds itself in seconds. 14 languages, conditional logic, real-time sentiment analysis. See how people felt, not just what they said. Free to build.

records.name: VPS Monitor
records.tagline: Minimal server monitoring with one-command setup
records.description: VPS Monitor does one thing: shows your CPU, RAM and disk usage in a clean dashboard. Setup takes 2 minutes — run one command on your server and you're done. Auto-restart on reboot included. Features: - Live CPU, RAM and disk usage - Email alerts above 90% CPU or RAM - 30 day history graphs - Private dashboard per user - One command setup Perfect for developers who want visibility without the complexity of Grafana or Netdata. 14-day free trial, then €4.99/month.

records.name: WebToolsPack
records.tagline: 140+ privacy-first, client-side web tools for developers
records.description: WebToolsPack is an all-in-one suite of over 140 free online tools. Securely convert PDFs, edit images, process video/audio, and manage text entirely in your browser. No registration required.

records.name: MissionLink
records.tagline: Let fans vote with their wallets.
records.description: Fans keep asking for: "Can you do this?" "Can you make that content?" "Would you ever try this?" Most creators handle everything manually in DMs. What if fans could fund those requests together? Let fans vote with their wallets.

records.name: Zerion
records.tagline: Encrypted P2P messenger over Tor. No servers, no accounts.
records.description: Zerion is a messenger built around one idea: there should be nothing to hand over, ban, or breach. Everything runs over Tor including voice and video calls. No phone number, no email, no central server. Your contacts are onion addresses. Post-quantum triple ratchet on every message. Dual profiles for plausible deniability. Encrypted local storage with anti-forensics. Public and private channels. Account backup encrypted with Argon2id and AES-256-GCM, transferable over Tor. Open source

records.name: HiRezGo!
records.tagline: Share full‑resolution photos instantly — no compression
records.description: HiRezGo! lets you share full-resolution photos instantly without compression. Most platforms reduce image quality or make large files hard to share. HiRezGo! solves this with simple link sharing. Viewers can zoom images instantly on any device, including smartphones. Key features: - No compression - Fast streaming viewer - No registration required - Works on mobile, desktop, and tablet Built for photographers and creators who care about image quality. Solo-built — feedback welcome!

records.name: Unweb
records.tagline: Give your website an AI-readable endpoint
records.description: Unweb makes any website AI-native. Publish structured content that AI agents can read fast, clean, and reliable. How it works: 1. Register — create a free account 2. Publish your site content — one API call 3. Done — your site is AI-readable at unweb.app/llms/your-site Features: Universal URL extraction — webpage to structured JSON LLM-powered analysis — DeepSeek classifies and summarizes One-click publishing — permanent AI-readable endpoint API key management — register, login, create keys

records.name: Avocado Domains
records.tagline: The ultimate expired domain hub with custom scoring logic
records.description: Avocado Domains is a programmable discovery platform for modern domain investors. Stop wasting hours scrolling endless spreadsheets. We activate your personal keyword lists into a dynamic, rule-based scoring engine that automatically screens over 100K expiring domains daily. Instantly spot hidden gems with historical favicon data and custom link templates tailored to your local workflow.

records.name: Oxygen Donuts
records.tagline: Crypto donations for Twitch streamers, built for OBS
records.description: Oxygen Donuts is a crypto donation service for streamers. Create a donation page, connect Twitch, add OBS alerts, and receive USDT, USDC, BNB, or ETH directly to your wallet. Viewers can send messages, TTS, memes, and payments by wallet, QR, or exchange. New streamers can create an embedded wallet in Oxygen with Privy or connect Rabby, MetaMask, or another EVM wallet.

records.name: KNITTWORKS
records.tagline: Harmonic Fusion Abstract Wall Art Print | Knittworks
records.description: Bold abstract fabric wall art in warm earthy tones. Washable, removable, swap-ready. No drilling, no wall damage. Ships across India.

records.name: Dascenda - Turn SEO insights into action
records.tagline: Your website's weekly SEO growth operator
records.description: Most SEO tools tell you what's wrong. Dascenda tells you what to do next. Run a site audit, discover content gaps and missed opportunities, get weekly Growth Moves with publish-ready content, and track whether Google responds through Search Console. Instead of endless reports, Dascenda helps you turn SEO insights into actions you can ship in minutes.

records.name: Torly.AI Visa Master
records.tagline: Six UK Innovator visa experts, inside your own Claude.ai
records.description: Get six UK Innovator Founder Visa specialists inside Claude.ai via the TorlyAI connector. 4F Innovation Matrix scoring, business-plan and financial scaffolding, endorsement matching, and interview coaching — powered by your own Claude subscription. £24/month, cancel anytime.

records.name: Figma Motion
records.tagline: Your Figma canvas now has a timeline
records.description: Motion now lives on the canvas—in the same file as your components, your variables, and your team—so your designs can come to life from day one.

records.name: MyTravAI
records.tagline: Your AI operating system for travel
records.description: Most travel tools generate itineraries. MyTravai goes further. Describe your trip in natural language and MyTravai builds a complete travel plan with destinations, activities, transportation, budget estimates, and personalized recommendations. As your preferences or conditions change, MyTravai adapts the plan in real time. Think of it as an AI operating system for travel, not just a trip planner.

records.name: Floor Color Maze
records.tagline: Casual Game
records.description: Just a game.

records.name: Postproxy - Engagement API
records.tagline: Publish, reply, and analyze social media via API
records.description: Postproxy is a social media API for products that need more than publishing. Publish posts, manage comments, DMs and reviews, track post and profile analytics, and receive webhooks across major platforms. Built for SaaS products, automation workflows, and agents that need reliable social media infrastructure without maintaining every platform API themselves.

records.name: Signspell
records.tagline: Real-time ASL alphabet recognition in py ,pip install and go
records.description: Signspell is an open-source Python package that recognises the American Sign Language fingerspelling alphabet live from your webcam. It works as both a command-line tool and an importable library. Install it, run one command, and start signing letters that appear on screen.Built with MediaPipe hand tracking and an LSTM model, it runs smoothly on an ordinary laptop CPU, no GPU required. MIT licensed and built for developers, students, and educators curious about computer vision and accessibility.

records.name: Tough Tongue AI for Sales
records.tagline: Live AI teammate for every tough sales conversation
records.description: Create *Live* AI teammates for every tough sales conversation. Each teammate shows up with human-like voice, avatar, and tools in minutes, can be deployed to phone, Google Meet, Zoom, or your application, and self-improves with every conversation. Use them to qualify leads, run autonomous product demos, coach new sales reps, and support your team live when the deal is on the line.

records.name: Numoloo
records.tagline: Know which calls and voicemails need attention first
records.description: Not every call or voicemail carries the same level of urgency, intent, or revenue potential. Numoloo analyzes every conversation for urgency, sentiment, and intent, helping businesses identify revenue opportunities, urgent customer issues, and routine follow-ups so they know what requires attention first.

records.name: Settli
records.tagline: Settle your accounts.
records.description: Settli, Settle your accounts. Track every debt, person by person. Native app for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch and Apple Vision Pro.

records.name: Genspark Design
records.tagline: Generate UI prototypes, videos, and posters with AI
records.description: Genspark Design generates UI prototypes, HTML animations, videos, and posters from a prompt. Upload Figma files to maintain brand consistency across outputs. For non-designers who need production-ready creative assets.

records.name: Snick Launch
records.tagline: Turn every scroll into a satisfying experience on Mac
records.description: Scrolling on Mac feels too quiet or too smooth. Snick adds deep liquid mechanical mouse scroll-like sounds and trackpad haptics to your Mac every time you scroll. • Select from 7 different sounds (More incoming) • Trackpad haptic nudges • Adjust in-app volume Every scroll gets more and more satisfying with Snick. Demo the app on the website itself, select the sound and scroll! The website demo doesn't do full justice to the app as the click density and responsiveness isn't precise.

records.name: Prmpt
records.tagline: your shell, your servers, your files. One app.
records.description: Prmpt is a fast, open-source terminal with an SSH host manager and SFTP built in — one app instead of three. Powered by Ghostty's VT engine. Free, no account, no subscription.

records.name: BusineSooq | سوق العمل
records.tagline: The leading marketplace for local services.
records.description: BusineSooq is a digital marketplace connecting customers with trusted professionals, freelancers, skilled workers, and service providers across the Arab world. Users can discover experts, compare profiles, request services, receive offers, and hire qualified professionals in 200+ categories, including home, business, legal, healthcare, education, consulting, maintenance, and technical services. Our mission is to make hiring trusted professionals simple, transparent, and accessible.

records.name: Brain² by ClickUp
records.tagline: One AI that knows your entire company and acts on it
records.description: Brain² knows every task, Doc, chat, and decision, and how they all connect. No re-explaining required. Pick any AI model, connect all your apps, and let AI work with full context of your company. Memory, agents, and MCP integrations built in.
